welle_k5.form.zone.name: Security zone
welle_k5.form.zone.kurz: The military holds the area while local councils and allied fighters run it: cheap, but abuses fall back on Türkiye.
welle_k5.form.zivil.name: Civil administration
welle_k5.form.zivil.kurz: The governor of the border province takes over schools, hospitals, power, the lira and PTT: costlier, resistance falls, refugees return.
welle_k5.form.satellit.name: Client state
welle_k5.form.satellit.kurz: A separate state recognised only by Türkiye, carried by yearly budget aid: stable, but expensive and with no diplomatic way out.
welle_k5.form.annexion.name: Annexation
welle_k5.form.annexion.kurz: The region becomes a Turkish province with residents, taxes and a constituency. The world does not recognise it: a vote at the United Nations, sanctions in stages.
welle_k5.form.rueckgabe.name: Return
welle_k5.form.rueckgabe.kurz: The region goes back to its country. The costs end and relations ease; nationalists call it betrayal.
welle_k5.gesetzt.zivil: A Turkish civil administration takes over in {region}.
welle_k5.gesetzt.satellit: A separate state recognised only by Türkiye is proclaimed in {region}.
welle_k5.fehler.provinz: The region is already a Turkish province. It can only be returned.
welle_k5.fehler.linie: Not possible on a ceasefire line without a treaty. Only a peace treaty creates the basis.
welle_k5.annexion.beschluss: The Grand National Assembly passes the law creating the province of {region}, number {plaka}. The governor takes office; the province gets its seats at the next parliamentary election.
welle_k5.annexion.vertrag: The peace treaty cedes {region} to Türkiye, as Hatay was in 1939. The Grand National Assembly creates province {plaka}.
welle_k5.un.gv.titel: General Assembly: {ja} states condemn the annexation
welle_k5.un.gv.text: The General Assembly declares the annexation of {regionen} invalid: {ja} in favour, {nein} against, {enth} abstentions, {abwesend} absent. For comparison: Crimea 2014 {krim}.
welle_k5.un.sr_an.titel: Security Council declares the annexation null and void
welle_k5.un.sr_an.text: The Security Council adopts the draft on {regionen}: {ja} in favour, {nein} against, {enth} abstentions. It calls on all states not to recognise the annexation; more states join the sanctions.
welle_k5.un.sr_veto.text: The draft on {regionen} fails because of a veto by {veto} ({ja} in favour, {nein} against, {enth} abstentions). The General Assembly will vote nonetheless.
welle_k5.un.sr_satellit.text: As with Northern Cyprus in 1983, the Security Council declares the proclamation in {regionen} invalid ({ja} in favour, {nein} against, {enth} abstentions) and calls on states to recognise no other state.
welle_k5.sanktion.stufe1: Travel bans and asset freezes on those responsible for the annexation. Risk premium +{risiko} basis points.
welle_k5.sanktion.stufe2: Sectoral sanctions: capital markets, defence, dual-use goods. Risk premium +{risiko} basis points, foreign demand −{nachfrage} points.
welle_k5.sanktion.stufe3: Tightening: more banks and companies, shorter loan maturities. Risk premium +{risiko} basis points, foreign demand −{nachfrage} points.
welle_k5.sanktion.stufe4: Investment and trade ban on the annexed region. Risk premium +{risiko} basis points, foreign demand −{nachfrage} points.
welle_k5.provinz.verloren.rueckeroberung: The enemy has retaken {region}. Province {plaka} no longer exists.
welle_k5.provinz.verloren.aufstand: An uprising has broken {region} away from Turkish rule. Province {plaka} no longer exists.
welle_k5.staat.krise: {land} exists only as a government in exile. There is no crisis to open against it.
welle_k5.staat.exil: {land} is fully annexed. A government in exile speaks for the country, no state recognises the annexation, the sanctions stay.
welle_k5.skandal.text1: Allied fighters have run {region} for {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. A United Nations report cites kidnappings for ransom, seized homes and levies on harvests.
welle_k5.skandal.text2: As the occupying power, Türkiye bears responsibility. Resistance in the region: {widerstand} of 100.
welle_k5.skandal.warum: Where proxies govern, their abuses fall back on Türkiye.
welle_k5.skandal.standard: Ankara stays silent on the report about {region}. It stays in the headlines.
welle_k5.skandal.grund: Report on abuses in a Turkish-controlled zone
welle_k5.skandal.opt.untersuchen.label: Investigate and withdraw the faction
welle_k5.skandal.opt.untersuchen.beschr: Military police investigate; the faction responsible leaves the region.
welle_k5.skandal.opt.untersuchen.ausgang: The faction in {region} is withdrawn; the investigation is under way.
welle_k5.skandal.opt.zivil.label: Take over the administration
welle_k5.skandal.opt.zivil.beschr: The governor of the border province takes over; the allies' councils step down.
welle_k5.skandal.opt.zivil.sperre: The region is no longer a security zone.
welle_k5.skandal.opt.bestreiten.label: Reject the allegations
welle_k5.skandal.opt.bestreiten.beschr: The foreign ministry calls the report one-sided.
welle_k5.skandal.opt.abwarten.label: Stay silent
welle_k5.skandal.opt.abwarten.beschr: No statement. The report still has its effect.
welle_k5.ui.reaktion_satellit: The world's response to the client state
welle_k5.ui.vertrag: cession by treaty after an attack on Türkiye
welle_k5.ui.vertrag_angriff: treaty under duress: first stage only
welle_k5.ui.schon_laufend: An annexation is already under way with this country: no new vote, the sanctions stay in force.
welle_k5.ui.hatay: As with Hatay in 1939: the former sovereign cedes the region by treaty after an attack on Türkiye. No vote, no sanctions.
welle_k5.ui.stufen: Sanctions on the Crimea pattern, imposed by: {wer}
welle_k5.ui.iwf: Ceiling: the Crimea sanctions cost Russia 1 to 1.5 % of GDP at first and up to 9 % over the medium term.
welle_k5.ui.ganzer_staat: {land} would then be fully annexed: only a government in exile would remain.
welle_k5.hh.kredit: Troops, administration and integration run outside the ministries and are booked on credit every month.
welle_k5.liste.sitze: · constituency with {n, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}
welle_k5.liste.sitze_ab: · constituency from the next parliamentary election
welle_k5.karte.name: {name} ({plaka})
